entries.name: gsp_main
entries.comment: First word of section 0 (.text, HYP). Called once by the reset entry (FFF59BD0); 29 of the 32 trap vectors point here too, and JAHI FFF40000 at FFF4A730/FFF4A7C0 restarts it. Programs the GSP I/O registers (C0000110, C0000150, C0000160, ...), then falls into the frame loop.
clears the two command-buffer flag words FFFCFC00 and FFF9FC00 (FFF40DF0, FFF40E30)
HSTCTLL (C00000F0) |= 80h: sets INTOUT, the 68k's level-3 interrupt: the GSP is ready

entries.name: main_loop
entries.comment: Frame loop: waits until the frame counter FFF716A0 (incremented by the display interrupt, FFF41F80) reaches FFF77E80 (FFF40F50-FFF40F90), clears it, then polls the two command buffers.

entries.name: poll_command_buffers
entries.comment: Idle loop FFF41010-FFF41160: a buffer is ready when its flag word reads FFFF, FFF9FC00 first (list at FFF9FC10), then FFFCFC00 (list at FFFCFC10). MAME's speedup sits here (init_stunrun: m_gsp_speedup_pc = FFF41070, handlers on writes to FFF9FC00 and FFFCFC00).
the idle PC MAME's speedup checks (harddriv.cpp init_stunrun); A0 = flag word of buffer FFF9FC00

entries.name: process_command_buffer
entries.comment: A5 = the ready list (FFF9FC10 or FFFCFC10): stores it in FFF77F30, skips the header block by the word at FFF77F50 (0440h bits in every capture, docs/08 section 3.1), reads the header (FFF4D940), runs the commands (CALLR FFF46E30 via FFF412A0), then flips the frame-buffer page in B4 (02000000 <-> 0203C000, FFF412F0-FFF41690) and waits for the display interrupt to take it.
page flip: the page just drawn is B4; the next list draws into the other one (MAME: somdump.lua meta B4 is the next page at buffer done)

entries.name: command_buffer_done
entries.comment: Clears the buffer's flag word (FFF418A0), sets HSTCTLL INTOUT (FFF41910) to interrupt the 68k at level 3, and returns to main_loop (FFF41940).
HSTCTLL (C00000F0) |= 80h: INTOUT, the 68k's level-3 interrupt (game handler 02143C acknowledges it)

entries.name: display_interrupt
entries.comment: Trap vector 10 (DI, the display interrupt; FFFFFEA0 holds FFF41C00): reprograms the display registers (DPYSTRT, DPYCTL, ...) and increments the frame counter FFF716A0 (FFF41F50-FFF41F90).

entries.name: cmd_7_som_list
entries.comment: Command 7: the SOM display list (docs/08 section 1). A5 points at the list's word 1 (T), A1 = A5 is the base of the table's offsets, A3 = A5 + T words = the first table entry (FFF44CA0-FFF44CC0); A13 = the header flags FFF77E60; A2 counts polygons into FFF716C0. Each entry e draws the command at word 1 + e (FFF45000); the FFFF ends the walk and the dispatcher continues after the list (FFF44D10).

entries.name: som_list_done
entries.comment: The table's FFFF: A5 = the word after it, i.e. after the copied list; returns to the dispatcher.

entries.name: som_next_entry
entries.comment: A5 = *A3++ (the next table entry); FFFF ends the list (CMPXY with A12 = FFFFFFFF, FFF45020); else A5 = A1 + 10h * entry, the command (FFF45040-FFF45050), and CALLR som_draw_command.

entries.name: som_draw_command
entries.comment: One SOM command: bit 15 of the command word -> skip (FFF450A0); bit 12 -> the image quad (FFF450D0 -> FFF48FC0, cmd_1); else a polygon: B0 = xl, A6 = xr, then FFF77E60 bit 3 (debug) or fill 3 -> draw_outline (FFF45800), fill 0 -> solid, fill 1 -> 15151515h, fill 2 -> 01010101h (the COLOR1 patterns of 2-bit pixels, FFF45150-FFF452A0).
fill = command word bits 10-11: 0 solid (B9 = FFFFFFFF), 400h three pixels in four (15151515h), 800h one in four (01010101h; colour byte 4 is always 15151515h, FFF45230), C00h outline

colour: the word at FFF71D20 + 10h * (command & 3FFh) (FFF452D0-FFF45320) into F4000000, the 2 bpp expander's colour (gsp_control_lo[0], harddriv_v.cpp:300): its low byte paints even pixels, its high byte odd ones
y = the command's fourth word: B9 rotated left by 4y (the stipple's phase), B0 = (y, xl), A6 = (y, xr) + (1, 1), both fractions = 80000000h (one half), A10 = 1: fill the top row first

entries.name: edge_step
entries.comment: Steps both edges by one row: A0 += A9 / B0 += B1 + carry (left), A4 += A7 / A6 += A8 + carry (right). B1 and A8 carry the slope's integer part + 10000h (y + 1) as 32-bit adds over the packed (y, x).

entries.name: fill_span
entries.comment: DADDR = B0, DYDX = A6 - B0 (SUBXY: V when xl > xr + 1 skips the row and the pattern rotation), FILL XY of one row in the 2 bpp window (PSIZE 2, the window W = 3 clips), then B9 rotated by 4 (the stipple moves two pixels per row)

entries.name: som_next_segment
entries.comment: A10 exhausted: the next 32-bit word pair. FFFFFFFF ends the polygon (FFF45520). Else the right slope (A7 = fraction << 16, A8 = integer + 10000h), the left slope (A9, B1), and A10 = the row count; the segment draws count - 1 more rows (DSJS at FFF45500).

entries.name: draw_outline
entries.comment: Fill 3 (or FFF77E60 bit 3): the top row (FFF459A0-FFF45A00), then per segment the two edges as lines from vertex to vertex (count - 1 rows; the x change = slope * (count - 1), integer part, MPYS at FFF45A90), then the bottom row (FFF45BF0). FFF77E60 bit 5 leaves the right edges out (FFF45B50).

entries.name: draw_edge_line
entries.comment: Bresenham set-up for LINE 0 from B2 by the delta in B0: major axis and its step in B12, the diagonal step in B11 (FFF45C60-FFF45DC0), LINE 0 (FFF45DD0) at PSIZE 2 through the 2 bpp expander (nothing here changes PSIZE), so a line pixel gets the colour word's byte for its parity, as a fill does (docs/08 section 4.4), return through EXGPC A8.

entries.name: trap29_delay
entries.comment: Trap vector 29 (FFFFFC40 holds FFF45FC0): a busy wait of 80000h iterations, RETI.
writes FFF5C8F0, a variable in section 2: the one loaded word MAME's VRAM no longer holds (tools/programs.py GSP_RUNTIME_WORDS)

entries.name: run_command_list
entries.comment: The command interpreter: B4 = page - A000h (40 rows of 400h bits: GSP y 28h is row 0 of the page), window (0, 28h)-(1FFh, 117h) (B5/B6), CONTROL = C0h (window clipping, W = 3), then per command: A4 = *A5+, CALL the entry (A4 >> 12) of command_table (FFF46F90-FFF47030). Codes 0 and F leave through FFF47050; E1-E3 reach it one call deeper through cmd_E (FFF472E0), with an unbalanced stack (docs/08 section 3.2).
the dispatcher's read of the next command word (somdump.lua's read taps on this read bracket the SOM list; CURPC = FFF46F90, meta.txt fb_som_pc)

entries.name: end_command_list
entries.comment: Commands 0 and F (and C out of range, JRHI at FFF4A550): drops the dispatcher's return address (ADDK 20h,SP), restores B4 and returns from run_command_list. E1-E3 arrive here from cmd_E's CALL A0 (FFF47370) with a second return address on the stack: ADDK drops cmd_E's, MMFM SP,B8 (FFF47090) pops the dispatcher's into B8, MMFM SP,A0-A14 restores the registers shifted by one long and RETS (FFF470D0) returns to a saved register's value (HYP: never used).

entries.name: command_table
entries.comment: 16 longs, the handler of each command code (the word's top nibble): 0 FFF47050 end, 1 FFF48FC0 image quad, 2 FFF47E20 line, 3 FFF47900 rectangle, 4 FFF48650 text, 5 FFF47AF0 window, 6 FFF477C0, 7 FFF44BF0 SOM list, 8 FFF489E0 image, 9 FFF48C20 palette, A FFF49AF0 dissolve, B FFF4A040, C FFF4A420 colour table, D FFF4A5C0 frame-buffer entry, E FFF472E0 (E0 image table, E1-E3 to FFF47050 one call deeper), F FFF47050 end. Data, not code.

entries.name: cmd_E
entries.comment: Command E: the low two bits index FFF47390: E0 -> FFF4A6F0 (image table), E1-E3 -> end_command_list through this routine's own CALL A0 (FFF47370), so the stack is unbalanced there (docs/08 section 3.2).

entries.name: cmd_6
entries.comment: Command 6: low byte -> A9, A10 = the data, CALLA FFF595B0 (M5d), then skips words up to and including an FFFF (FFF478A0).

entries.name: cmd_3_rectangle
entries.comment: Command 3: colour = low byte twice (also stored in FFF5C8F0, FFF479B0), DADDR = the first long (y, x), DYDX = the second (dy, dx), FILL XY with B9 = FFFFFFFF in the 2 bpp window. 5 words.
writes FFF5C8F0 (see FFF46340)

entries.name: cmd_5_window
entries.comment: Command 5: x0, y0, x1, y1, clamped to x <= 1FFh and y in 28h-117h, into WSTART/WEND (B5/B6). 5 words. The SOM list draws inside the window the last command 5 set (y 28h-F7h in the captures: the dashboard rows stay untouched).

entries.name: cmd_2_line
entries.comment: Command 2: colour = low byte twice, x0, y0, x1, y1: a line (LINE 0/1) or an axis-parallel FILL, at PSIZE 8. 5 words.

entries.name: cmd_4_text
entries.comment: Command 4: colour = low byte twice, then a font word (FFFF: the previous, FFF71BE0), x (FFFF: continue at the previous end, FFF71BC0) and y, then the string, NUL-terminated bytes padded to a whole word (CALLA FFF46210; FFF48950-FFF489C0 rounds A5 up).

entries.name: cmd_8_image
entries.comment: Command 8: three words (the third's bits 7C20h go into CONTROL with C0h) and a long, handed to FFF58950 (M5d). 6 words.

entries.name: cmd_9_palette
entries.comment: Command 9: palette entries from the low byte on: a count n, then three words per two entries and two words for an odd last one (the packing of the colour components: M5d), into FFF6F650 and FFF70650 (FFF48D00-FFF48F40); FFF71650 = 1 asks the display interrupt to load them.

entries.name: cmd_1_image_quad
entries.comment: Command 1, and SOM commands with bit 12: scales image (command & 3Fh) of the table FFF78150 into the box from the first point to (second x, third y), 8 bits per pixel, pixel 0 transparent (CONTROL E0h), with sanity checks on the box (FFF49230-FFF49650; FFF77E60 bit 4 lifts the size limits). The corners are read with field 0, 16 bits zero-extended (ST FE0 = 0, MAME: make fieldext), so none is ever negative: the JRNN after the p1.x read (FFF49390) is always taken, and p1.x >= 8000h is a wide box only the 15Eh limit rejects. Image: height, width, then pixels from 60h bits on. Skips the remaining points to FFFFFFFF (FFF499D0).

entries.name: cmd_A_dissolve
entries.comment: Command A: one word, the step of a pseudo-random walk that copies 1DE00h pixels between the two pages (PIXT *A0,XY,*A1,XY at FFF49F00). 2 words.

entries.name: cmd_B
entries.comment: Command B: no operands: CALLA FFF52060 on the page 20000h bits further (M5d), then restores the default window and CONTROL. 1 word.

entries.name: cmd_C_colour_table
entries.comment: Command C: the low two bits pick a quarter of the colour table FFF71D20 (100h words each, FFF4A460-FFF4A4A0), then a start index (low byte), a count and count words; start + count above 100h abandons the whole list (JRHI FFF47050). The SOM polygons index this table with their command word's bits 0-9.

entries.name: cmd_D_fb_entry
entries.comment: Command D: the low two bits pick a 40h-bit entry at FFF71C20: a long (an 8-bit VRAM address, converted to the 2 bpp window: (a - FFC00000) / 4 + 02000000; 0 stays 0) and a second long. 5 words.

entries.name: cmd_E0_image_table
entries.comment: Command E0: a start (at most 3Fh) and a count, then count longs (halves swapped) into the image table FFF78150 that cmd_1_image_quad reads. Out of range (start > 3Fh, JAHI FFF40000 at FFF4A730; start + count > 40h, FFF4A7C0) restarts gsp_main instead of leaving the list.

entries.name: read_list_header
entries.comment: From the list's header block (FFF77F30): word 11h -> FFF77E60 (flags: bit 3 all polygons as outlines, bit 4 lifts the image-quad limits, bit 5 outlines without right edges), word 13h -> FFF77E70, word 12h -> FFF77E80 (the frames main_loop waits per list: 3 in game, 20 lists a second).

entries.name: reset
entries.comment: Reset entry: trap vector 0 at FFFFFFE0 holds FFF59920; the 68k never writes the PC, it releases HLT (02C1C4). A13 = A14 = FFF793D0 (HYP: C program stack), SP = FFF98790, then clears FFF6F580-FFF98BB0 (FFF59A20) and runs the section 1 records (FFF59B20) before calling gsp_main. The shape of TI's C start-up (boot.asm c_int00), HYP.

entries.name: clear_bss
entries.comment: Clears FFF6F580 (the end of the loaded image) up to FFF98BB0 (A11 to A12) in 32-bit fields, then the tail in bytes (FFF59AD0-FFF59B10). Covers the frame counter FFF716A0; the command buffers FFF9FC00/FFFCFC00 lie above it.
A10 = FFF5A170, the start of section 1; if not FFFF, CALLA FFF59C70 processes it (HYP: TI C auto-initialisation records, .cinit)
CALLA gsp_main
CALLA FFF59DD0 (HYP: exit) if gsp_main returns

entries.name: run_init_records
entries.comment: Called with A10 = FFF5A170: walks the records of section 1 (HYP: TI C .cinit, each a length, a destination and the data).

entries.name: section1
entries.comment: Section 1, FFF5A170-FFF5C8F0 (68k 01C4C0-01C9B0): read by run_init_records at start-up (HYP: .cinit records, not code; the disassembly here is noise).

entries.name: section2
entries.comment: Section 2, FFF5C8F0-FFF6F580 (68k 01C9B8-01EF4C): initialised data (HYP: .data); its first word FFF5C8F0 is a variable the code writes (FFF46340, FFF479B0).

entries.name: trap_vectors
entries.comment: Section 3, FFFFFC00-FFFFFFFF: the 32 TMS34010 trap vectors, 32 bits each, vector n at FFFFFFE0 - 20h * n. 0 reset = FFF59920, 10 (DI) = FFF41C00, 29 = FFF45FC0, every other = FFF40000.
